configuration.boundary: du/dn = g, nonhomogeneous Neumann, manufactured from u*
configuration.objective: integral (0.5|grad u|^2 - f u) - boundary g u + (sigma/2)(integral u - M)^2
configuration.kernel: Gaussian exp(-|y|^2/2); stable pair columns E cosh z and E t sinhc z
configuration.geometry_bounds: centres [-2,2]^2, angles unbounded, 0<h<=1.5 without positive floor
configuration.coefficient_fit: one linear solve of (S + sigma m m') c = L + sigma M m after column scaling
configuration.work_accounting: one unit per distinct coefficient solve, including line-search probes and post-transfer refits
configuration.optimizer: L-BFGS-B ftol0 gtol0 maxcor12 maxls40; history reset only on actual completion
configuration.transfer: analytic whole-plane H1 pair bound; no multiplier factor is needed in this Neumann formulation
configuration.limitations: fixed Gaussian scale and supplied pairing; no certified objective gate; quadrature agreement is not validated integration
